author: The Pilot News
title: Statement Collective Expands Its 925 Sterling Silver Jewellery Range for Bold, Everyday Wear
text:
Australia - 29 July, 2026 - Statement Collective ( statementcollective.com ) is deepening its position in the Australian jewellery space with a growing lineup of 925 sterling silver jewellery built for people who treat accessories as part of their identity, not just a finishing detail.
Cast in solid 925 sterling silver, the collection brings the brand’s signature design language — tattoo culture, gothic forms, underground art, punk references and modern street style — into a precious metal made to be worn daily. Rather than leaning into quiet minimalism, Statement Collective focuses on pieces with weight, texture and symbolism that stand out on the hand, wrist and neck.
“Sterling silver lets us do something stainless steel can’t,” said a Statement Collective spokesperson. “The metal is softer, so it holds finer detail, develops its own patina over time, and carries real, lasting value. Our customers want jewellery that feels personal, wearable and connected to who they are — silver that tells the story rather than following a trend.”
Sterling Silver Rings
The brand’s 925 sterling silver rings anchor the range, with styles including the Barbed Wire Ring, Razor Wire Ring, Flame Ring, Skull Heart Ring, Roman Numerals Ring and the new Tattoo Signet Ring featuring laser-engraved tiger, skull, spider web, snake and barbed wire detailing. Each is designed to be stacked, rotated or worn solo for a strong visual impact.
Sterling Silver Chains
The 925 sterling silver chains collection carries the same streetwear edge, spanning heavy Cuban links, “The Cathedral” spiked chains, barbed wire Cuban styles and cleaner cable and curb options. Built heavy and textured, they’re made to pair with pendants or stand alone as statement necklaces.
Sterling Silver Pendants
Pendants remain central to the brand’s look, with the 925 sterling silver pendants range featuring pieces like the Razor Blade Pendant, Dagger Pendant, “3 of Swords” barbed-wire heart and Skull Heart Pendant — designs made to be layered into a silver stack or worn on their own.
Sterling Silver Bracelets
The brand has also grown its 925 sterling silver bracelets, adding spiked cuffs, “The Cathedral” spiked bracelets and diamond-cut cable styles that round out a full head-to-hand silver look. Every piece in the collection is designed as unisex, with no rules on how it’s worn.
As more shoppers look for accessories that feel expressive rather than generic — and that hold value over time — Statement Collective is positioning its sterling silver range as raw, everyday statement pieces crafted from 92.5% pure silver, built to last and improve with wear.
About Statement Collective
Statement Collective is an Australian jewellery brand crafting bold, contemporary pieces inspired by street culture, music, tattoo art and modern styling. Each design is created to elevate everyday wear through strong silhouettes, detailed finishes and a distinct visual identity.
